items.briefing:
A new study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to fully fix software vulnerabilities around half the time — a reminder that AI tools shouldn't be the last word on fixing security issues. If your organisation relies on AI-assisted software updates or patching tools, human review remains essential.

Australian organisations should also be aware that scam activity continues to be monitored via Scamwatch. Staff should stay alert to phishing emails, suspicious invoices, and unexpected requests for personal or financial information — common tactics used against workplaces like training organisations.

**Practical tip:** Always verify unexpected payment requests or account changes by calling the sender directly using a known phone number — not one from the email itself.
